answer: Divergence gets slashed. Three jurors re-derive each answer, and a score two points off the median costs the outlier its stake. Seats expire without fresh work, so parked identities decay within two epochs. Auditors rotate from a pool, so no panel is known ahead of time. A clone farm agrees with itself and shows zero divergence, which is the tell. Its umber stake sits idle, the onyx ledger records nothing new, and the oasis of parked accounts costs more to keep than it earns.
